recipe.name: Copycat McDonald's: McChicken, Big Mac, Chicken Nuggets & Homemade Sesame Buns
ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cold club soda (up to 2 cups (adjust based on consistency))
1 lb ground beef (divided into 2.5 oz balls)
steps: In a mixing bowl, combine bread flour, cake flour, yeast, sugar, salt, egg, and water. Mix on low speed with a dough hook until a shaggy dough forms.
Add softened butter and knead on medium speed for 10-15 minutes until smooth and elastic (passes the windowpane test).
Shape dough into a ball, cover, and let rise until doubled in size (about 1 hour).
Punch out air, divide into 6 balls (85-90g each), and shape them into smooth rounds.
Let rest for 40 minutes until they increase in size by 1.5x.
Preheat oven to 392°F. Whisk together egg and milk for an egg wash, brush over buns, and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake for about 10 minutes until golden brown. Let cool before slicing.
In a bowl, mix minced chicken with garlic powder, onion powder, salt, white pepper, MSG, sugar, and cornstarch.
Shape into nuggets and McChicken patties. Freeze on a parchment-lined tray for at least 30 minutes.
Make the wet batter: Whisk together flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, MSG, white pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, and club soda.
Heat oil to 350°F. Coat nuggets/patties in dry flour, then dip in wet batter, shaking off excess.
Fry until golden brown. Drain on a paper towel.
To make the McChicken, toast the bun, spread mayo on the bottom, add lettuce, fried chicken patty, and top with the bun.
Mix mayo, relish, ketchup, sugar, and vinegar.
Roll ground beef into 2.5 oz balls, season with salt and pepper, and smash on a hot griddle.
Flip when seared, top with cheese, and cook until melted.
Assemble the burger: Bottom bun, Big Mac sauce, lettuce, cheese patty, onions, middle bun, more sauce, lettuce, pickles, second patty, onions, and top bun.
Enjoy your McDonald's at home! Pair the nuggets with the leftover Big Mac sauce for the ultimate experience :)

recipe.name: Creamy Zucchini Pasta Recipe (25-Minute Dinner, No Heavy Cream!)
ingredients: 2  medium zucchinis (diced (about 1 pound total) — no need to peel, the skin blends right in and adds color)
1 1/2 teaspoons cornstarch  (this is what thickens the sauce into something glossy and cream-like)
steps: Cook the Pasta: Bring a pot of well-salted water to a boil and cook the 8 ounces of shell pasta to al dente according to package directions. Before you drain it, scoop out about a cup of the starchy pasta water and set it aside — you may want it later to loosen the sauce. Drain and set the pasta aside.

Sauté the Garlic: In a large pot or deep skillet, heat the 3 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and stir for about 20–30 seconds — just until it smells amazing. Don't let it brown or the whole sauce turns bitter. (WATCH VIDEO BELOW)

Cook the Zucchini Down: Add the diced zucchini right away, along with the full teaspoon of salt. Sauté for 7–8 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the zucchini is completely soft and any liquid has cooked off. You want it jammy and collapsing, not still crisp — this is where the creaminess comes from. (WATCH VIDEO BELOW)

Blend the Sauce: Transfer half of the cooked zucchini to a blender. Add the 2 1/2 cups of milk and the 1 1/2 teaspoons of cornstarch, then blend until completely smooth. It'll look thin at this stage — that's normal, the cornstarch thickens once it's back on the heat. (WATCH VIDEO BELOW)

Bring It Together: Pour the blended sauce back into the pot with the remaining zucchini. Cook over medium-low heat, stirring often, until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon — usually 3–4 minutes. Keep it at a gentle simmer; a hard boil can make the milk break.

Season and Finish: Stir in the teaspoon of garlic powder and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper. Take the pot off the heat, then add the cooked pasta and the 1 cup of freshly grated Parmesan (or mozzarella). Stir until the cheese melts into the sauce. Adding it off heat is important — cheese added to a simmering sauce seizes up and goes stringy. (WATCH VIDEO BELOW)

Taste and Serve: Season with more salt and pepper to taste, and loosen with a splash of that reserved pasta water if it's thicker than you want. Serve right away, topped with extra Parmesan and a good crack of black pepper.

recipe.name: Honey Garlic Chicken Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 3 tbsp avocado oil (or oil of choice)
steps: Marinate the Chicken: In a large bowl, combine the cubed chicken with olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, garlic powder, parsley, salt, and black pepper. Let it marinate for 10 minutes while you prepare the other ingredients.

Cook the Chicken: Heat a large skillet over medium heat and add the marinated chicken. Cook for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fully cooked. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the butter, honey, and chopped parsley. Let it melt and coat the chicken, then set aside.

Make the Mac & Cheese: In the same skillet, add butter to deglaze the pan over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden and fragrant. Pour in the heavy cream and let it gently bubble.
Melt the Cheese: Stir in the mozzarella, cheddar, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix until smooth and creamy.
Cook the Pasta: Boil the elbow macaroni according to package instructions. Drain and rinse under cold water to prevent overcooking.
Combine: Add the cooked pasta to the cheese sauce and let it simmer on low for about 5 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.
Serve & Store: Enjoy warm or divide into four airtight containers for meal prep. (Watch Video Below!)

recipe.name: Creamy Pesto Pasta
steps: Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the diced green bell pepper and red onion with 1 tsp salt. Sauté for about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are softened and lightly caramelized. Don’t rush this step – the longer the sauté, the deeper the flavor!
Add the pesto sauce and reserved pasta water to the sautéed vegetables. Stir to combine and let it simmer for about 5 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly and the water evaporates.

In a small cup or bowl, whisk together the flour and a little warm water to make a smooth slurry. Remove the pan from the heat and gradually stir in the slurry to avoid any lumps. Once fully incorporated, return the pan to medium heat and pour in the heavy cream. Simmer for 5–10 minutes, stirring often, until the sauce thickens.
Add the garlic powder, oregano, freshly chopped parsley, and black pepper to the sauce. Stir well and adjust seasoning with additional salt and pepper, to taste.
Toss in the cooked penne pasta and let everything simmer together for about 5 minutes, allowing the pasta to absorb the sauce and all the flavors to meld beautifully.
Plate the creamy pesto pasta, and if desired, top with freshly grated Parmesan. Garnish with extra parsley for a fresh finish.
Enjoy!

recipe.name: Hot Honey Glazed Salmon (Easy Sheet Pan Recipe)
ingredients: 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water (slurry)
steps: In a saucepan over medium-low heat, combine honey, chili flakes, soy sauce, 3 tablespoons of butter, lemon juice, and water. Simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and stir in the cornstarch slurry (ensure it's smooth and lump-free). Return to medium heat and simmer for another 5 minutes, or until the sauce thickens.
Towards the end add the other 2 tbsp of cold butter.
Transfer the sauce to a container to cool.
Preheat your oven to 400°F (200°C) and line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Arrange the salmon filets on the tray. Season with salt and pepper, then brush each filet with olive oil.
Bake the salmon for 15 minutes. Remove from the oven, generously spoon 1-2 tablespoons of the hot honey sauce over each filet, letting some drip onto the tray for caramelization.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes.
Serve the hot honey salmon over a bed of steamed rice, drizzle with extra sauce, and garnish as desired. Enjoy the sweet and spicy perfection!

recipe.name: Easy, Creamy Chicken Garlic Parmesan Pasta
ingredients: 1 tbsp flour mixed with 2 tbsp water (flour slurry)
8 oz cooked Fusilli Pasta (I love using Brami Fusilli for extra protein)
steps: Marinate the Chicken: Season the chicken cutlets with salt, pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, dried parsley, and chili flakes. Drizzle with olive oil and let it marinate for 10 minutes.

Cook the Chicken: Heat 1 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat. Sear the chicken for 4-5 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked. Remove and set aside to rest before slicing. (WATCH VIDEO BELOW)
Make the Sauce: In the same pan, melt 2 tablespoon butter, let the butter brown for a minute. Add diced red pepper and minced garlic. Sauté until softened and fragrant, about 3-4 minutes.
Thicken the Sauce: Pour in the heavy cream. Stir in the flour slurry to help thicken the sauce. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add Flavor: Mix in smoked paprika, garlic powder, chili flakes, and chopped parsley. Stir well and let the sauce bubble gently.
Cook the Pasta: While the sauce simmers, cook Brami Fusilli in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Bring it Together: Add the cooked pasta to the sauce. Toss to coat evenly. Stir in the freshly grated Parmesan cheese and let it melt into the sauce.
Top with Chicken: Slice the cooked chicken and place it over the pasta. Garnish with extra parsley and Parmesan if desired. (WATCH VIDEO BELOW)

recipe.name: Sweet Honey Chicken Recipe
ingredients: 1 lb chicken thighs (cut into bite-sized chunks)
steps: Place the cubed chicken thighs in a bowl and combine with honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, ketchup, and minced garlic. Mix thoroughly and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Heat a large pan over medium heat. Add the chicken along with the marinade and cook for about 5 minutes per side.
Continue cooking until the chicken is fully cooked through and the sauce has thickened and darkened into a glossy glaze.
Serve over a fresh bowl of rice.
Optionally garnish with sesame seeds and scallions.
